Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoBuy
Description: Private Market Board helper that searches configured gear keywords and buys listings at or below a configurable gil cap.
Punchline: Buy underpriced gear sets from the Market Board.
Changelog: Removed the max purchases per run limit. AutoBuy now listens for full inventory or full armoury purchase errors and moves to the next item instead of repeatedly trying the same blocked item type.
